fix(release): include codex plugin manifest in sync-versions targets

The codex .codex-plugin/plugin.json was missing from sync-versions.js's
targets list, so it drifted while every other manifest kept getting
bumped — sat at 2.2.0 while package.json reached 2.3.7. Adds the
target and catches codex up to 2.3.7 in the same commit so the next
`pnpm bump` cleanly takes everything from 2.3.7 to the new version
instead of jumping codex two minor versions at once.

fix(food_preference_engine): fix off-by-one in rolling avg (Bug 22)

Phase 1 increments total_count via ON CONFLICT UPDATE, then Phase 2
re-reads the row. The count fetched is already N+1, but the formula
added +1 in the denominator again, effectively computing (avg*N+new)/(N+2).

Fix: capture previous_count BEFORE the upsert; use it as the multiplier.
The post-increment old_count only appears as the denominator, giving
(avg*previous_count + new) / old_count = (avg*N + new) / (N+1) ✓
